title: Finite-support witnesses for satisfiable CNFs using assignment locality
claim: For the imported CNF evaluation definitions, a CNF is satisfiable exactly when it has a satisfying assignment that is false on every variable absent from that CNF. The forward direction restricts an existing witness to finite support and invokes the exact locality theorem credited through PR #7 to preserve evaluation.
novelty: A new accepted artifact would connect the earlier locality theorem to a concrete SAT-witness normalization property. The mathematics is established and the conclusion is not a complexity breakthrough. This proof was prepared by the same project as an openly disclosed trial fixture before submission; it requests modest formalization/integration credit, not independent discovery.
